Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
Our group didn't know how to handle this situation :

There are 3 methuselah's left. One successfully passes a vote of
Ancilla Empowerment. All methuselah's, including the one casting the
vote, loses enough pool to oust them.

Question : does anyone get 6 blood, or the ante card from their prey,
when there is such a simultaneous ousting?

_______________
Ethan Burrow

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
et...@ddg.com (Ethan Burrow) writes:

>Our group didn't know how to handle this situation :

> There are 3 methuselah's left. One successfully passes a vote of
>Ancilla Empowerment. All methuselah's, including the one casting the
>vote, loses enough pool to oust them.

> Question : does anyone get 6 blood, or the ante card from their prey,
>when there is such a simultaneous ousting?

No. All three get a victory point (and their respective Prey's ante).
Since they were all ousted at the same time as their Prey, no one gets
six pool. Jyhad [18.1] VtES (10)
